    Fischbacher's Lemma 5.2 #

    In a chain-bounded ray category with cancellation that is cycle-free, interval-finite, and in which every cocycle on a finite convex set is a coboundary there: for paths v, w : a ⇝ b and a point d on v, a chain joins d to a point of w (lemma52).

    The hull-shrinking step (ZWalk.Good.step) splits a zero t-path into its first arrow, takes a minimal chain of links between the first arrows of t and s (separation criterion at the valley), and applies the case analysis of §5.3–5.4.

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.ZWalk.Good.step {A : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} A] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms A] [IsRayCategory A] (hcf : ∀ (x : A) (p : Quiver.Path (RayVert.mk x) (RayVert.mk x)), p.length = 0) (hint : ∀ (a b : A), (interval a b).Finite) (hsc : ∀ (D : Set A), D.Finite → ConvexR D → ∀ (c : ArrowWeight A), (IsCocycleOn D fun {x y : RayVert A} => c) → IsCoboundaryOn D fun {x y : RayVert A} => c) (hL : LeftCancel A) (hR : RightCancel A) (hCB : ChainBounded A) {b a₀ : A} {w : Quiver.Path (RayVert.mk a₀) (RayVert.mk b)} {z : ZWalk b} (hz : z.Good w) (h0 : ∃ σ ∈ z.segs, pathVal σ.t = 0) :
    ∃ (z' : ZWalk b), z'.d₀ = z.d₀ ∧ z'.Good w ∧ z'.hull ⊂ z.hull

    The hull-shrinking step (Fischbacher §5.3–5.4).
